mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates and increased liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their respective 3-month moving averages indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising (e.g., by >0.25% in the last month).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a sharp labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy approaches a recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 level above 19500 (billions of chained 2017 dollars) indicates a late-cycle expansion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to profit-taking and reduced growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 19500.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average consistently predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in a weakening manufacturing sector.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines.
